prompt: I'm a technical writer working at an AI-focused SaaS company, and I want to refresh my resume to highlight my contributions to our API documentation and emerging AI tooling experience. I have my current resume, my manager's Betterworks review showing strong feedback, and an older version of my CV. Can you create both Markdown and HTML versions that emphasize my documentation engineering work and are optimized for ATS parsing? I want the HTML version to be portfolio-ready for GitHub Pages.

assertions.name: resume-markdown-exists
assertions.description: Outputs include a properly formatted resume.md file

assertions.name: resume-html-exists
assertions.description: Outputs include a valid, responsive resume.html file

assertions.name: ai-llm-expertise-highlighted
assertions.description: Resume prominently features AI/LLM documentation expertise and prompt engineering skills

assertions.name: quantified-api-documentation
assertions.description: Includes quantified metrics on API documentation impact (e.g., reduced support questions, developer audience size)

assertions.name: documentation-engineering-terminology
assertions.description: Uses modern 'documentation engineer' or 'documentation engineering' terminology, not just 'technical writer'

assertions.name: ci-cd-automation-featured
assertions.description: Highlights CI/CD automation achievements (e.g., bug detection rates, automation percentage)

assertions.name: high-value-specialty-keywords
assertions.description: Includes high-value, specialty keywords: API Documentation, OpenAPI, Docusaurus, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, LLM

assertions.name: manager-rating-integrated
assertions.description: Incorporates manager performance ratings (4.7/5 overall, competency scores) as validation

assertions.name: portfolio-github-ready
assertions.description: HTML version is self-contained, responsive, and explicitly GitHub Pages ready

assertions.name: mentorship-leadership
assertions.description: Highlights mentorship and team development contributions from performance review
